You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How much profit does Sasha make by selling all the leftover lumber? Prices for lumber have gone up 50% in the last few months after Sasha bought the lumber. Sasha has ten leftover 2 x 4 x 10 boards that cost $10 each. Sasha has five leftover 4 x 4 x 10 boards that cost $16 each. Sasha sells all of the leftover lumber.
